title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 87
description: Ten questions on Psalms 87: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion, the city of God where the peoples are recorded as born.

questions.text: Where is "his foundation", according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "His foundation is in the holy mountains."

answers.text: In the depths of the sea

questions.text: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than what?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

answers.text: All the temples of the nations

questions.text: To whom does verse 3 say glorious things are spoken?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: "Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God."

questions.text: Which two are recorded first among those who acknowledge God in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me."

questions.text: Which land is named in verse 4 along with Philistia and Tyre?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia."

questions.text: Of which place will it be said, "This one and that one was born in her"?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "Yes, of Zion it will be said, 'This one and that one was born in her.'"

questions.text: Who will establish her, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "the Most High himself will establish her."

questions.text: What will Yahweh do when he writes up the peoples?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, "This one was born there."

questions.text: Who say "All my springs are in you" in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says those who sing as well as those who dance say this.

answers.text: Those who sing and those who dance

questions.text: What do the singers and dancers say in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says they say: "All my springs are in you."

answers.text: "We will go up to your house."
